observation.command: docker ps --filter name=openproject --format 'Container: {{.Names}} | State: {{.Status}} | Image: {{.Image}}'; echo; echo "=== Data persistence ==="; du -sh /var/lib/openproject/pgdata /var/lib/openproject/assets 2>/dev/null; ls /var/lib/openproject/pgdata | head -8; echo; echo "=== Key log lines ==="; docker logs openproject 2>&1 | grep -E "default admin credentials|Database setup finished|Puma version|Listening on" | head -6; echo; echo "=== HTTP checks ==="; curl -s -o /dev/null -w "GET /login -> %{http_code}\n" --max-time 30 http://localhost:8080/login; curl -s --max-time 30 http://localhost:8080/login | grep -oE "<title>[^<]*</title>"
